14.3.1.title: Overview of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events (Safety Population)
rows: Subjects with at least one TEAE, n (%)
Subjects with at least one Grade >=3 TEAE, n (%)
Subjects with at least one Serious TEAE, n (%)
Subjects with at least one Treatment-Related TEAE, n (%)
Subjects with at least one Treatment-Related Grade >=3 TEAE, n (%)
Subjects with TEAE Leading to Treatment Discontinuation, n (%)
Subjects with TEAE Leading to Dose Reduction, n (%)
Subjects with TEAE Leading to Dose Interruption, n (%)
footnotes: TEAE = Treatment-Emergent Adverse Event
TEAEs are AEs with onset on or after first dose and up to 28 days after last dose
A subject with multiple events in a category is counted once

adsl.name: Subject-Level Analysis Dataset
adsl.description: One record per subject with demographics, baseline, and disposition

TRTSDT.label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment

TRTEDT.label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment

adae.name: Adverse Events Analysis Dataset
adae.description: One record per adverse event per subject

TRTEMFL.description: Treatment-emergent if onset on/after first dose and up to 28 days after last dose

worst_grade.rule: Keep maximum ATOXGRN per USUBJID per AEDECOD
worst_grade.description: For subjects with multiple occurrences, use worst grade

adtte.name: Time-to-Event Analysis Dataset
adtte.description: One record per subject per time-to-event parameter

TTP.censor: Death censored at date of death

adrs.name: Response Analysis Dataset
adrs.description: One record per subject per response parameter per assessment

BOR.confirmation: CR and PR require confirmation >= 4 weeks

DCR.definition: BOR = CR, PR, or SD (SD >= 6 weeks)

steps: 2. Apply RECIST 1.1 criteria to each assessment
3. For CR: require confirmation >= 4 weeks after initial CR
4. For PR: require confirmation >= 4 weeks after initial PR
5. SD: require minimum duration (e.g., >= 6 weeks from baseline)
6. Select best response using hierarchy: CR > PR > SD > PD > NE

adlb.name: Laboratory Analysis Dataset
adlb.description: One record per subject per lab test per timepoint

shift_table_derivation.post_baseline_worst: Maximum ATOXGRN across all post-baseline visits
shift_table_derivation.population: Subjects with both baseline and >= 1 post-baseline value

definition.description: A precise description of the treatment effect reflecting the clinical question posed by the trial objective

components.population: The patients targeted by the clinical question
components.variable: The endpoint or outcome of interest
components.population_level_summary: How individual patient outcomes are combined

treatment_policy.name: Treatment Policy Strategy
treatment_policy.description: The value of the variable regardless of whether the intercurrent event occurs
treatment_policy.approach: Continue follow-up and data collection regardless of intercurrent event
treatment_policy.example: Continue to assess PFS even if patient discontinues treatment
treatment_policy.use_case: Reflects what happens in real-world clinical practice

composite.name: Composite Strategy
composite.description: The intercurrent event becomes part of the endpoint
composite.approach: Combine endpoint with intercurrent event into composite outcome
composite.example: PFS composite = progression OR death OR discontinuation due to toxicity
composite.analysis: Analyze composite endpoint as new variable
composite.use_case: When intercurrent event itself is clinically meaningful

hypothetical.name: Hypothetical Strategy
hypothetical.description: Envision a scenario where intercurrent event would not occur
hypothetical.approach: Estimate what would have happened in absence of ICE
hypothetical.example: What would OS be if patients had not switched to active treatment?

principal_stratum.name: Principal Stratum Strategy
principal_stratum.description: Target population defined by intercurrent event potential
principal_stratum.approach: Restrict to patients who would/would not experience ICE
principal_stratum.example: Treatment effect in patients who would complete treatment
principal_stratum.use_case: Understanding effect in specific patient subgroups

while_on_treatment.name: While-on-Treatment Strategy
while_on_treatment.description: Response to treatment prior to intercurrent event
while_on_treatment.approach: Censor at time of intercurrent event
while_on_treatment.example: PFS while on treatment (censor at discontinuation)

pfs_treatment_policy.population: All randomized patients with measurable disease
pfs_treatment_policy.variable: Time from randomization to progression or death
pfs_treatment_policy.ice_strategy: Treatment policy (continue follow-up regardless of treatment discontinuation)

os_hypothetical.ice_strategy: Hypothetical (what if placebo patients had not crossed over to active treatment)

visit_windowing.description: Rules for assigning actual visit dates to scheduled visits
rules: If visit falls within window, assign to scheduled visit
If visit falls outside all windows, create as unscheduled visit
If multiple visits within same window, use visit closest to target day
For efficacy endpoints, unscheduled visits may be excluded

baseline_definition.general_rule: Last non-missing value prior to or on date of first dose

specific_rules.laboratory: Last value prior to first dose (may be screening)
specific_rules.vital_signs: Last value prior to first dose
specific_rules.tumor_assessment: Last assessment prior to first dose (within 28 days)

on_treatment.end: Date of last dose + 28 days (for AEs) or date of last dose (for efficacy)
on_treatment.description: Period of active treatment plus safety follow-up

post_treatment.end: End of study or data cutoff

survival_follow_up.description: Continue until death or study end

means.rule: One more decimal place than raw data
means.example: If raw data has 1 decimal, report mean with 2 decimals

standard_deviation.rule: Two more decimal places than raw data
standard_deviation.example: If raw data has 1 decimal, report SD with 3 decimals

medians.example: If raw data has 1 decimal, report median with 1 decimal

laboratory.same_day: Use scheduled visit value; if both unscheduled, use latest
laboratory.multiple_values: For continuous: use mean; for categorical: use worst

vital_signs.same_day: Use average of measurements taken at same timepoint

adverse_events.multiple_occurrences: Count subject once per PT; use worst grade
adverse_events.overlapping_events: Keep as separate events in listing; count once in summary

tumor_assessments.same_day: Use assessment from scheduled visit; if conflict, query

missing_day.ae_start_before_trt: Last day of month (conservative for TEAE determination)

date_imputation.documentation: All imputed dates flagged with imputation indicator

components.n_per_arm: Sample size for comparing two proportions

selection.minimum_size: 10 mm longest diameter (CT/MRI) or 20 mm clinical exam
selection.lymph_nodes: >= 15 mm short axis to be target
selection.measurability: Must be measurable in 2 perpendicular dimensions

measurement.sum_diameters: Sum of longest diameters of all target lesions

target_lesions.baseline: SLD (Sum of Longest Diameters) at baseline

non_target_lesions.definition: All other lesions not selected as target

new_lesions.definition: Any lesion not present at baseline
new_lesions.size_requirement: No minimum size (but must be unequivocal)
new_lesions.confirmation: If equivocal, confirm at next assessment

CR.name: Complete Response
CR.lymph_nodes: All lymph nodes < 10 mm short axis

PD.name: Progressive Disease
PD.target: >= 20% increase in SLD from nadir AND >= 5 mm absolute increase
PD.new_lesions: Appearance of one or more new lesions
PD.confirmation: May require confirmation for clinical trials

CR.requirement: All CR criteria must be met again

PR.requirement: SLD must still be >= 30% decreased from baseline

PD.requirement: If required, PD criteria must be met at subsequent assessment

rules: SD requires minimum duration from baseline
If SD duration not met, assign NE
PD at any time = PD for BOR (unless later assessments show response)

bone_lesions.target: Lytic or mixed with soft tissue component >= 10 mm
bone_lesions.response: Must show healing (sclerotic fill-in) for CR

cystic_lesions.target: Only if meet definition of simple cyst and >= 10 mm

previously_irradiated.target: Can be target only if documented progression after radiation

treatment_emergent.onset: On or after date of first dose
treatment_emergent.end: Up to 28 days after date of last dose (or up to start of new anticancer therapy)
treatment_emergent.worsening: Pre-existing condition that worsens (increase in grade) after first dose

determination_rules: If AE start date equals first dose date, TEAE = Yes
If AE start date after last dose + 28, TEAE = No
If AE start date missing but end date is during treatment, TEAE = Yes (conservative)

categories: Any TEAE Leading to Dose Modification

by_soc_pt.sorting: SOC alphabetically, PT by decreasing frequency
by_soc_pt.counting: Subject counted once per PT (worst grade)

shift_tables.format: Baseline Grade (rows) x Worst Post-Baseline Grade (columns)
shift_tables.population: Subjects with baseline AND >= 1 post-baseline value

criteria: AND ALP < 2x ULN (to exclude biliary obstruction)
hys_law.evaluation: Listing of all potential Hy's Law cases with causality assessment

summary.continuous: Mean (SD) at baseline and each post-baseline visit
summary.shift: Baseline category vs worst post-baseline category

treatment_duration.formula: (Date of last dose - Date of first dose + 1)

dose_intensity.relative: (Actual dose intensity / Planned dose intensity) x 100

dose_modifications.summary: N (%) with each type of modification

safety.rationale: Attributes AEs to actual treatment received

efficacy.outside_window: Exclude from primary analysis; include in sensitivity

safety.rule: Include all assessments regardless of timing
safety.display: Show in by-visit summaries or listings

re_screening.definition: Subject screened more than once before randomization
re_screening.rule: Use only final screening values for baseline
re_screening.exclusion: All prior screening data excluded from analysis datasets

study_discontinuation.timing: >= 30 days after last dose for final safety
study_discontinuation.survival_follow_up: Continue until death or study termination

approaches.complete_case: Analyze only subjects with complete data
approaches.bocf: Baseline observation carried forward (conservative for efficacy)
approaches.multiple_imputation: Create multiple completed datasets, combine results
approaches.mmrm: Mixed model for repeated measures (handles missing under MAR)

sensitivity_analyses: Tipping point analysis (vary assumptions about missing)

periods.concomitant: Start date <= last dose date + 28 and end date >= first dose date

prohibited.action: List separately with dates and impact on analysis
prohibited.efficacy_impact: May censor at date of prohibited therapy
